info.name: Student Grades API
info.description: Complete API for managing student grades, connecting manual grading and automatic quiz/assignment scores

item.name: 1. SAVE GRADE (Admin Manual Entry)
item.description:
Save or update a student's period grades (Prelim, Midterm, Finals). Final grade is auto-calculated.

**Database:** Creates/updates `grades` collection with `{ courseId, studentId }` as unique key

**Response:** Saved grade object with auto-calculated finalGrade

**Use Cases:**
- Admin manually enters Prelim grade for a student
- Admin updates Midterm grade after period review
- Admin finalizes all Finals grades for the course

item.name: 2. SYNC GRADES FROM ASSESSMENTS
item.description:
Automatically sync and calculate a student's grade based on all their quiz and assignment submissions.

**Database:** Auto-fetches QuizSubmission and AssignmentSubmission records, then updates the grade

**Response:** Updated grade object with calculated finalGrade from all assessments

**Use Cases:**
- After admin grades a quiz submission manually
- After admin grades an assignment
- Force recalculation of student's current assessment-based grade
- Integration point for auto-grading systems

item.name: 3. GET ALL GRADES
item.description:
Retrieve all student grades across all courses (Admin only).

**Database:** Queries entire `grades` collection

**Response:** Array of all grade records

**Use Cases:**
- Generate comprehensive grade report
- Grade analytics dashboard
- Bulk export for records
